infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Form uses your microphone when you choose to dictate an answer.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Form transcribes answers on this device when supported. You review them before saving.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Form connects to your private family training service.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Form uses your camera only when you choose to take progress photos.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Form reads the workouts, steps, energy, heart rate, sleep and body weight you choose to share from Apple Health to adjust your training.
